name: v1.25.0
body:
## Known Issues - macOS: crash when window is minimized if the log is open and docked #9206 - deskflow-core can always start a new instance #9216 - windows: user should clear settings or remove`C:\ProgramData\Deskflow` before upgrading to 1.25.0 #9224 - macOS 13+ is required to use the builds we provide. Use on macOS 12 will require locally building ## Features - Support Gui Translation without exiting [#9086](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9086) ([sithlord48](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/commit/9906421460c3f1ecda439f708f4c714f88a2ba04)) - Italian translation [#9108](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/pull/9108)
